REASON FOR VISIT: Follow-up for seasonal allergies, 2 weeks after starting antihistamine.

INTERVAL HISTORY: Patient reports mild improvement in sneezing and congestion, no new symptoms.

PHYSICAL EXAM: Nasal mucosa mildly boggy, no purulent discharge, lungs clear bilaterally, no distress.

ASSESSMENT: Seasonal allergic rhinitis, improving.

PLAN: Start oral corticosteroid taper for presumed sinus infection and refer to ENT for evaluation.
